title: POST /api/projects/:id/github/releases/:rid/summarize — AI changelog summary from commits
description: Generate an AI-written changelog summary for a GitHub release by analyzing the commits included since the previous release.
acceptanceCriteria: POST requires auth and project ownership
Returns 400 if user has no AI API key
Returns 404 if release not found for this project
Fetches commits between previous release and this one
Generates human-readable changelog from commit messages

steps.details: 1) getOwnedProject. 2) Fetch user — check ai_api_key. 3) Find release WHERE id = rid AND project_id. 4) Find previous release by published_at DESC WHERE published_at < this.published_at. 5) Fetch commits between previous.published_at and this.published_at. 6) Build prompt: 'Write a concise changelog for version TAG based on these commits: [commit list]. Use markdown with categories: Features, Fixes, Other.' 7) Call AI. 8) Save to release.ai_summary. 9) Return 200 { summary }.
Connect GitHub repo with releases. Call summarize on a release. Verify ai_summary is set and is readable markdown.
